prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one transparent production sprite sheet for a LIMITED modular right-arm prototype of the SAME adult muscular anime boxer in the reference image. Match his warm bronze skin, sculpted natural muscle volume, dark painted game-anime outlines and upper-left frontal light. The reference is STYLE and ANATOMY only; do not draw the rest of the boxer. Draw EXACTLY THREE SEPARATE disconnected parts in one horizontal row, with generous transparent gaps, no labels: LEFT: complete anatomical RIGHT upper arm including a smooth rounded deltoid shoulder cap and a rounded fully painted elbow overlap cap, shoulder at top and elbow at bottom, slightly leaning left, front-facing. CENTER: complete matching RIGHT forearm in raised guard orientation, elbow at bottom-left and wrist at top-right, full muscle surface, smoothly rounded elbow extension for overlapping beneath the upperarm and wrist extension. RIGHT: matching small clenched bare right fist viewed from front in boxing guard, thumb naturally tucked across fingers, wrist extending downward, no glove. Draw hidden overlap surfaces, not severed anatomy: these are clean game-rig sprites, no blood, no exposed bone, no cut cross sections, no empty holes. All pieces have consistent skin and scale: upper arm shoulder-to-elbow approximately 300 pixels, forearm elbow-to-wrist approximately 330 pixels, fist wrist-to-top approximately150 pixels on a 1024square canvas. Entire visible three pieces contained centrally, exact transparent background, no cast shadow outside parts, no body, no clothing, no text, no diagram lines. High-quality careful anatomy and refined hand with five digits, not a medical illustration.
method: Three disconnected generated components extracted with alpha-connected-component segmentation; no repaint, 4-connected nonzero alpha islands over10000pixels; authored registration and uniform scaling per part in build-premium-v2-rig.cjs

correction.prompt: Precise-object-edit of the attached THREE-PART ARM SPRITE SHEET. Keep every part's position, scale, base angle, bronze skin colour, upper-left light and all main muscle anatomy unchanged. Correct ONLY the joining surfaces for a natural skeletal game rig: (1) center forearm's TOP wrist termination must be a narrow smoothly tapering cylindrical skin extension with softly rounded flat end, NEVER a flared trumpet or cuff, no sharp dark cut seam. (2) right fist's BOTTOM wrist extension must similarly be straight narrow and rounded, half the current broad bottom width, to fit into the forearm wrist without flared lips; fingers and thumb unchanged. (3) soften and integrate the circular ball highlights at the BOTTOM elbow cap of left upper arm and BOTTOM-LEFT elbow cap of center forearm into natural tendon/skin overlap. No hard circular kneecap lines. These caps overlap during motion, so keep a simple smooth natural rounded muscle termination without sharp interior seam or bulge. Exactly three disconnected components remain on true transparent background. No new objects, no labels, no skeleton, no clothing, no medical cross section, no blood. This is corrective polished anime game art, not a diagram. Keep clear transparent gaps between parts and preserve image framing.
